items.title: MGM Stock Slumps 9% After-Hours — Barry Diller’s People Inc. Scraps Proposal to Buy Out MGM Resorts
items.summary: Media executive Barry Diller's People Inc. has abandoned its multi-billion-dollar proposal to purchase the remaining shares of MGM Resorts International.

items.title: Barry Diller Withdraws Bid for MGM Resorts
items.summary: The billionaire had been in talks with the casino operator after offering in June to take a majority stake.

items.title: MGM Resorts (MGM): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: MGM Resorts currently trades at $37.90 per share and has shown little upside over the past six months, posting a middling return of 2.6%. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 16.4% gain during that period.

items.title: DraftKings Dips Have Usually Paid, But Does This Drop Count?
items.summary: DraftKings (DKNG) trades near $22.50, about 14% below the recent high it set on 21st August 2026. Sharp falls in this stock have been worth buying before: the median dip gained 41% over the next twelve months. The same record says the wait was long, and this fall is not the kind it is built on. Consider what those falls paid.

items.title: 3 Consumer Stocks We Steer Clear Of
items.summary: Most consumer discretionary businesses succeed or fail based on the broader economy. Over the past six months, it seems like demand may be facing some headwinds as the industry’s 3.8% return has lagged the S&P 500 by 9.4 percentage points.

items.title: MGM Stock Slips 14% in 3 Months: Is the Pullback a Buying Opportunity?
items.summary: MGM's 13.9% three-month slide puts its growth plans in focus, but uneven Vegas demand, digital losses and heavy Osaka spending cloud the buy case.

items.title: BetMGM CEO pitches sportsbooks over prediction markets ahead of NFL season
items.summary: Asking For A Trend host Josh Lipton talks with BetMGM CEO Adam Greenblatt ahead of the NFL season's start as prediction markets like Polymarket begin to compete with regulated betting markets.
